hints.tr: Başlangıç kodu `o'brien`'da sorgu hatası veriyor ve `<i>`'yi olduğu gibi yazıyor.
hints.en: The starter code raises a query error on `o'brien` and writes `<i>` as it is.
`?` and `(author,)` in the query; `html.escape(body)` in the output.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı: ```python import html import sqlite3 def comments_html(rows, author): db = sqlite3.connect(":memory:") db.execute("CREATE TABLE comments (author TEXT, body TEXT)") db.executemany("INSERT INTO comments VALUES (?, ?)", rows) query = "SELECT body FROM comments WHERE author = ? ORDER BY rowid" found = db.execute(query, (author,)).fetchall() return ["
  • " + html.escape(body) + "
    • " for (body,) in found] ROWS = [ ["ada", "hi"], ["bob", "a & b"], ["o'brien", "x < y"], ["ada", "second"], ] for author in ["ada", "o'brien", "zeynep"]: print(author) for line in comments_html(ROWS, author): print(" ", line) ```
